description: The UFZ collection locates renewable-energy installations throughout Germany and supplies associated technical attributes. Its February 2026 release derives from the Marktstammdatenregister, with locations checked and corrected by the research team. GeoPackage layers cover wind turbines, photovoltaic installations, bioenergy and cogeneration units, hydropower, renewable-gas production and storage. Photovoltaic field polygons and CSV tables are also provided. Zenodo distributes the files free under the German Data Licence, attribution, version 2.0. Some registry entries are excluded because they cannot be assigned reliable locations, and historic releases have different coverage and terms. The current inventory includes 33,433 wind turbines and 14,250 solar-energy point records. It can supply spatial generation assets for capacity-planning and hazard-exposure simulations alongside model-pypsa; electrical connectivity must come from another source.
name: Geo-locations and System Data of Renewable Energy Installations in Germany
